mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_TBL VALUES (#{userId}, #{hashPwd}, #{userName}, #{email}, #{userAddr}, #{phone}, 'C', 'O', SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT O.ORDER_ID) FROM ORDER_TBL O LEFT JOIN USER_TBL U ON U.USER_ID = O.USER_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}

WITH ORDERED_LIST AS ( SELECT DISTINCT O.ORDER_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM ORDER_TBL O LEFT JOIN USER_TBL U ON U.USER_ID = O.USER_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId} ) SELECT SE.STORE_ID, O.STORE_NAME, P.PRO_NAME, T.OPTION_NAME, S.VALUE_NAME, OPT.ADD_QUANTITY, OPT.PRICE_DIFF, D.PRICE, D.QUANTITY, D.LETTERING_WORD, D.SUBTOTAL, O.ADD_OPTION_PRICE, O.DELIVERY_FEE, O.DELIVERY_TYPE, O.FULL_ADDRESS, O.CHAT_YN, O.ORDER_DATE, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.STATUS, C.CHAT_ID, OPT.PRICE_DIFF*OPT.ADD_QUANTITY AS OPTION_TOTAL, PI.PICK_TIME, DELI.WISH_DELI, SE.STORE_ADDR, O.ORDER_ID, D.ORDER_DETAIL_ID, OPT.ORDER_OPTION_ID, T.TOP_OPTION_ID, S.SUB_OPTION_ID FROM ORDER_TBL O LEFT JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TBL D ON O.ORDER_ID = D.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ORDER_OPTION_TBL OPT ON OPT.ORDER_DETAIL_ID = D.ORDER_DETAIL_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_TBL P ON D.PRO_NO = P.PRO_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL T ON T.TOP_OPTION_ID = OPT.TOP_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL S ON S.SUB_OPTION_ID = OPT.SUB_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL SE ON SE.STORE_NAME = O.STORE_NAME LEFT JOIN USER_TBL U ON U.USER_ID = O.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CHAT_TBL C ON C.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN DELIVERY_TBL DELI ON DELI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PICKUP_TBL PI ON PI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN ORDERED_LIST OL ON OL.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE OL.RN BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{fetchRows} ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE DESC

SELECT SE.STORE_ID, O.STORE_NAME, P.PRO_NO, P.PRO_NAME, T.OPTION_NAME, S.VALUE_NAME, U.USER_NAME, OPT.ADD_QUANTITY, OPT.PRICE_DIFF, D.PRICE, D.QUANTITY, D.LETTERING_WORD, D.SUBTOTAL, O.ADD_OPTION_PRICE, O.DELIVERY_FEE, O.DELIVERY_TYPE, DELI.DELIVERY_STATUS, CASE WHEN O.DELIVERY_TYPE = 'D' THEN DELI.DELIVERY_STATUS WHEN O.DELIVERY_TYPE = 'P' THEN PI.PICKUP_STATUS ELSE NULL END AS DELIVERY_STATUS, O.FULL_ADDRESS, O.CHAT_YN, O.ORDER_DATE, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.STATUS, C.CHAT_ID, OPT.PRICE_DIFF*OPT.ADD_QUANTITY AS OPTION_TOTAL, PI.PICK_TIME, PI.PICKUP_STATUS, DELI.WISH_DELI, SE.STORE_ADDR, O.ORDER_ID, D.ORDER_DETAIL_ID, OPT.ORDER_OPTION_ID FROM ORDER_TBL O LEFT JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TBL D ON O.ORDER_ID = D.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ORDER_OPTION_TBL OPT ON OPT.ORDER_DETAIL_ID = D.ORDER_DETAIL_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_TBL P ON D.PRO_NO = P.PRO_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL T ON T.TOP_OPTION_ID = OPT.TOP_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL S ON S.SUB_OPTION_ID = OPT.SUB_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL SE ON SE.STORE_NAME=O.STORE_NAME LEFT JOIN USER_TBL U ON U.USER_ID=O.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CHAT_TBL C ON C.ORDER_ID=O.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN DELIVERY_TBL DELI ON DELI.ORDER_ID=O.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PICKUP_TBL PI ON PI.ORDER_ID=O.ORDER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE DESC

SELECT * FROM ORDER_DETAIL_TBL D LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_TBL P ON D.PRO_NO=P.PRO_NO LEFT JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON S.STORE_ID=P.STORE_ID LEFT JOIN ORDER_TBL O ON O.ORDER_ID=D.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN USER_TBL U ON U.USER_ID=O.USER_ID WHERE D.ORDER_DETAIL_ID=#{orderDetailId}

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.ORDER_ID, R.PRO_NO, R.USER_ID, R.STORE_ID, R.STORE_NAME, R.RATING, R.REVIEW_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(R.CDATETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CDATETIME, PRO.PRO_NAME, U.USER_NAME, I.IMG_PATH FROM REVIEW_TBL R LEFT JOIN USER_TBL U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_TBL PRO ON PRO.PRO_NO = R.PRO_NO LEFT JOIN REVIEW_IMG_TBL I ON R.REVIEW_ID = I.REVIEW_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.CDATETIME DESC

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.ORDER_ID, R.PRO_NO, R.USER_ID, R.STORE_ID, R.STORE_NAME, R.RATING, R.REVIEW_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(R.CDATETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS C_DATE_TIME, PRO.PRO_NAME, U.USER_NAME FROM REVIEW_TBL R LEFT JOIN USER_TBL U ON U.USER_ID=R.USER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_TBL PRO ON PRO.PRO_NO=R.PRO_NO WHERE U.USER_ID=#{userId}
SELECT * FROM QA_TBL Q INNER JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON Q.STORE_ID=S.STORE_ID WHERE Q.USER_ID=#{userId} ORDER BY QUESTION_DATE DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{fetchRows} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Q.QUESTION_ID) FROM QA_TBL Q INNER JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON Q.STORE_ID=S.STORE_ID WHERE Q.USER_ID=#{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT C.CHAT_ID AS chatId, O.ORDER_ID AS orderId, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, C.LAST_MSG_AT AS lastMsgAt, C.LAST_MSG AS lastMsg, P.PRO_NAME AS proName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MSG_TBL M WHERE M.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID AND M.USER_ID!=#{userId} AND M.IS_READ = 'N') AS unreadCount FROM CHAT_TBL C INNER JOIN ORDER_TBL O ON O.ORDER_ID = C.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TBL D ON D.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCT_TBL P ON P.PRO_NO = D.PRO_NO INNER JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON S.STORE_ID = P.STORE_ID WHERE O.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY C.LAST_MSG_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_MSG_TBL SET IS_READ='Y' WHERE USER_ID!=#{userId} AND ORDER_ID=#{orderId} AND IS_READ='N'
